The '''Senate Emergency Response''' was an organization within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Overview==
This body was formed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the event that a catastrophe so great that it destroyed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] government structure. It was used only once in galactic history which was after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took on the position of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] of the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The Senate Emergency Response was formed to declare martial law on Coruscant after Palpatine claimed that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was responsible for an attempted assassination on his life. The first action authorized by the Emergency Response division was surrounding the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to prevent any spread of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rebellion.
